1. (Currently amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, __wherein said fins and diodes are arranged such that each fin is positioned between adjacent diodes and extends radially outward from the columnar body__.

2. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open __and said columnar body has a length-to-width ratio of at least 2:1__.

3. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes, __wherein said optic element is integrally formed with or mechanically secured to said fins__.

4. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material __and said phosphor material is configured to convert at least a portion of blue light from said diodes to white light__.

5. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body __and are mounted on flat faces of said columnar body__.

6. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __such that the angular spacing between adjacent fins equals the angular spacing between adjacent diodes__.

7. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section __and has a length exceeding its maximum cross-sectional width__.

8. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body __and said diodes are positioned on the flat faces rather than at the corners__.

9. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body __and extends radially outward from said corner__.

10. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face __and said single diode on each face is positioned centrally on that face__.

11. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK __and said material comprises aluminum or copper alloy__.

12. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 9 __wherein__ a single optic element is disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode __and said optic element is configured to direct light outward from the columnar body__.

13. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base __and is configured to mate with a standard lamp socket__.

14. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current __and further includes a voltage regulator and thermal management circuitry__.

15. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body __and is shaped as a lens or diffuser positioned adjacent to said diodes__.

16. (Currently amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, __wherein said body has a length-to-width ratio of at least 2:1 and said diodes are positioned on flat faces between adjacent fins__, said lamp having a general A19 outline.

17. (Currently amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body, __positioning fins at corners of said body such that each fin is disposed between adjacent diodes__, and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK __and comprises aluminum alloy__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins __positioned at the corners of the polygonal cross-section__.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body has substantially straight side walls __and a length exceeding its maximum cross-sectional width__.
